title: Privacy
description: What personal data implesta processes on its website and in its app, why, where it is stored, who receives it, and what you can ask us.
lead: Last updated [[publication date]]. This policy covers implesta.com and the implesta app: what personal data we process, why, and what you can ask us.

paragraphs: {legalName} ("implesta", "we"), enterprise number {enterpriseNumber}, a company registered in Belgium. For anything about your data, write to {privacyEmail}. If implesta moves to a company of its own, we update this policy and tell our customers in advance.
For our website, our sales contacts and our customers' account and billing details, we decide how personal data is used. For those, we are the **controller**.

For the data our customers put into implesta, such as their clients, contacts, people, projects, hours and invoices, the customer is the controller. We process that data only on the customer's instructions, under a data processing agreement, and we are the **processor**. If you work for one of our customers, or are a client of one, please contact that company first about your data. We help them answer you.

We count visits with Plausible Analytics, which sets no cookies and stores no personal data. We see which pages are read, from which country, and which website a visitor came from, never who you are. Because nothing is stored on your device, there is no cookie banner.
The website is served by Google Firebase Hosting, which processes technical data such as IP addresses to deliver the pages and protect them against abuse.
We ask for your name, work email and team size, and note the page you came from, so we can prepare the call. Bookings are handled by Cal.com. [[Cal.com's data region: EU or US.]]

We use these details to hold the demo and follow up on it, because you asked us to (steps before a possible contract) and because it is in our legitimate interest to follow up with companies that showed interest. If no contract follows, we delete your booking details within 12 months.

To give a customer's people access to implesta, we process their name, work email, role, sign-in details (your password is stored only as a secure hash, never readable), two-factor settings and a log of actions in the app. For billing, we process the name and email of the customer's billing contact.

We do this to provide the service under our contract with the customer, to keep it secure, and to meet our accounting and tax obligations. Account data is deleted within 30 days after the contract ends. Invoices are kept as long as Belgian accounting and tax law requires.

sections.h2: Data our customers store in implesta
paragraphs: Each customer's data lives in its own database, on Google Cloud in Belgium (europe-west1). We use it only to provide implesta to that customer, never for our own purposes, never for advertising, and we never sell it.

When a contract ends, the customer can export its data. We delete it within 30 days, and it disappears from our backups when they expire. How the data is protected is described on [security and data](page:security).

sections.h2: Optional features that send data to other services
paragraphs: These features are off until a customer's administrator switches them on, or until you connect your own account. The Admin settings in the app show which service receives which data.
**Meeting summary:** meeting notes and action items are sent to Anthropic (Claude) to draft a summary.
**Project health rating:** a project manager's status notes and the project's budget, hours and dates are sent to Google (Gemini) to suggest a rating. [[Region, once moved to Vertex AI in the EU.]]
**Calendar sync:** if you connect your Google or Microsoft calendar, implesta exchanges your bookings with that calendar. See the section on calendar data below.
**Slack:** if a customer connects its own Slack workspace, implesta posts the notifications that customer chooses there, such as leave requests.

When you connect a calendar, implesta [[exact access: which calendar data implesta reads and writes, matching the scopes requested]]. We use this data only to keep your implesta bookings and your calendar in step.

We don't use calendar data for advertising, don't sell it, don't use it to train AI models, and don't transfer it to others except as needed to provide this feature, for security, or when the law requires it. People at implesta don't read it unless you ask us to for support. You can disconnect your calendar at any time in your profile; implesta then stops syncing and deletes the connection details.

implesta's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
We use these service providers. Each processes data only for us, under a written agreement.
**Google Cloud:** hosting of the app, its databases and this website. App and databases in Belgium (europe-west1).
**Resend:** sending the app's emails, such as invitations and notifications. EU region.
**[[Geocoding provider]]:** turning client addresses into map positions for the CRM map.
**Plausible Analytics:** website statistics, without personal data. EU.
**Cal.com:** demo bookings.
**Slack:** product feedback you send us from inside the app, with your name and email.
**Anthropic and Google (Gemini):** only if the optional AI features above are switched on.

Some of these providers may process data outside the European Economic Area, for example in the United States. Where they do, the transfer is protected by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or by an adequacy decision, such as the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
The website sets no cookies. The app uses one cookie that is strictly necessary to keep you signed in. It needs no consent, and it is never used for tracking.

You can ask us what personal data we hold about you, and ask us to correct it, delete it, restrict its use, or give it to you in a portable format. You can object to processing based on our legitimate interest. Write to {privacyEmail}; we answer within one month.
If you think we handle your data wrongly, you can complain to the [Belgian Data Protection Authority](https://www.dataprotectionauthority.be).
When we change this policy, we update the date at the top. If a change affects how we process our customers' data, we tell them by email before it takes effect.
